remarks: Live in Style, Comfort, and Unbeatable Convenience! Welcome to this crisp and well presented 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhome in the sought-after Newfield East Complex on Belltown Road-just a short stroll to houses of worship and one of Stamford's most charming shopping centers. Step inside to discover newly refinished hardwood floors throughout, a spacious and inviting layout, and abundant natural light. The main living area opens to your private deck, perfect for grilling, unwinding, or simply soaking up the sun. Enjoy the ease of in-unit washer and dryer, AC units, and assigned off-street parking-plus plenty of guest parking for when friends and family visit. Just steps away, you'll find everything you need: grocery store, fresh bakery, inviting restaurants, CVS Pharmacy, and more. It's truly one of the most convenient locations in Stamford-and that's why homes here rent in days, not weeks. Schedule your showing-before this gem is gone!
